offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures recreational vehicles, including travel trailers, fifth-wheels and motorhomes, plus buses, sold mainly through independent dealers to consumers and to transit fleet buyers.

primary_products.value: travel trailers; fifth-wheel trailers; motorhomes; buses; van conversions

customer_segment.value: B2C: Consumers buying recreational vehicles through dealers; B2B: Dealers and rental or leisure fleet operators; B2G: Public transit agencies buying buses

end_markets.value: recreational travel; public transportation; leisure vehicles

revenue_model.value: product sales: Vehicles sold to independent dealers and fleet buyers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds vehicles from purchased chassis and components, sold to dealers and transit agencies; brand owner: Owns and markets multiple recreational vehicle and bus brands

geography_served.value: global: North America and Europe, with sales in other regions

specialization.value: related lines: Towables, motorhomes, van conversions and buses sharing dealers and manufacturing know-how

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent recreational vehicle dealers; direct sales: Direct fleet sales to transit agencies and fleet operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Vehicle safety and emissions standards, such as NHTSA and EU type-approval rules
